scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run db:generate && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.db:deploy: npm --prefix backend run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test:ci && npm --prefix frontend run test:ci
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
